=== query ""
  MatchLocalPodcasts  -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query
  MatchBackendPodcast -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query
  ResolvePodcastGroup -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query
  ResolveBackendGroup -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query
  ParseGroupKind      -> "" ok=false
  matchesPodcastName("The Daily Show") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("Lex Fridman Podcast") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("123 Numbers") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("") -> false

  MatchLocalPodcasts  -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query

  ResolvePodcastGroup -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query
  ResolveBackendGroup -> <nil> | err=empty podcast query
  ParseGroupKind      -> "" ok=false
  matchesPodcastName("The Daily Show") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("Lex Fridman Podcast") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("123 Numbers") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("") -> false
=== query "daily"
  MatchLocalPodcasts  -> <nil> | err=dlynw | Daily_News / dlysh | Daily_Show
  MatchBackendPodcast -> <nil> | err=id-Daily_News | Daily_News / id-Daily_Show | Daily_Show
  ResolvePodcastGroup -> <nil> | err=dlynw | Daily_News / dlysh | Daily_Show
  ResolveBackendGroup -> <nil> | err=id-Daily_News | Daily_News / id-Daily_Show | Daily_Show
  ParseGroupKind      -> "" ok=false
  matchesPodcastName("The Daily Show") -> true
  matchesPodcastName("Lex Fridman Podcast") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("123 Numbers") -> false
  matchesPodcastName("") -> false
